title: Transcriptional responses in whole blood of healthy adult volunteers experimentally challenged with S. Paratyphi
description: This study describes the transcriptional response in whole blood derived from healthy adult volunteers experimentally infected with S. Paratyphi A. Samples were collected at D0, D0+12, D4, D6 (or D7), D28. Participants were challenged with low dose (LD) or high dose (HD). The clinical results of this study have been published in: Dobinson et al. Evaluation of the Clinical and Microbiological Response to Salmonella Paratyphi A Infection in the First Paratyphoid Human Challenge Model. Clin Infect Dis. 2017 Apr 15;64(8):1066-1073. This RNA-seq dataset has been partially included in: Blohmke CJ, Muller J, Gibani MM, Dobinson H et al. Diagnostic host gene signature for distinguishing enteric fever from other febrile diseases. EMBO Mol Med 2019 Oct;11(10):e10431
